headline: Marban Hollow Stirs as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Three hours on, Marban Hollow takes the late lead with six changes in two hours and thirty-four in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral against two, three and three before. Weathered Expanse has quickened to five late changes and sixty-one in the day at Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, now two Warden, five Colonial and two neutral. Kuura Strand has cooled to four late changes and thirty-five in the day at Faden Point and Menneen, holding one Warden to five Colonial. Nevish Line stays hot with four late changes and twenty in the day at Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way, now five Warden to three Colonial, with 1,067 Colonial and 1,039 Warden casualties in two hours. Linn Mercy shows no late change despite 778 Colonial and 1,071 Warden casualties in two hours, while Farranac Coast, Pari Peak and Stonecradle are quiet in two hours and Callahan's Passage reports heavy losses with no recorded flip.
